meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上ulw-loop后，Claude会按照一个严格的工作循环执行任务：先读取流程指南，然后逐步分解目标，每一步记录可观察的证据，并自动管理状态和子代理。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词，或者要求进行持久的、有证据约束的任务执行时触发。

say.text: 请使用ulw-loop模式，将我的项目目标分解为有证据的步骤。
say.note: Claude会读取指南并启动目标循环。

say.text: 执行ulw-loop: 创建目标并逐步更新计划。
say.note: Claude会注册目标并开始执行循环。

say.text: 用ulw-loop处理这个长期任务，每步要证据。
say.note: Claude会进入证据驱动的工作模式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude adopts a goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps. It reads a reference guide, registers goals, executes atomic steps with observable evidence, and manages state and subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', or similar keywords, or asks for durable, evidence-led task execution with checkpoints.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break my project into evidence-backed steps.
say_en.note: Claude reads the guide and starts the goal loop.

say_en.text: Execute ulw-loop: create goals and update plan step by step.
say_en.note: Claude registers goals and begins execution.

say_en.text: Handle this long-term task with ulw-loop, each step with evidence.
